content.title: When Will April Social Security Payments Arrive? Your Guide to the Payment Schedule
content.text: Updated April 01, 2026 12:30 PM EDT Some social security payments will arrive April 1. Wesley Lapointe / For The Washington Post via Getty Images 0 seconds of 33 secondsVolume 0% How to Reach Financial Freedom: 12 Habits to Get You There KEY TAKEAWAYS Social Security payments are typically distributed on Wednesdays every month, based on the beneficiary's birth date.Supplemental Security Income payments for April will be issued on the first. Get personalized, AI-powered answers built on 27+ years of trusted expertise. The Social Security Administration distributes benefits to more than 75 million people each month. Here is when to expect yours in April. Payments are primarily distributed according to beneficiaries' birth dates. The exception is those who began receiving retirement, spousal, or survivor benefits before May 1997, who typically receive their payments on the 3rd of every month. Why This Matters Since Social Security beneficiaries are on a fixed income, knowing when their payments will arrive is essential for creating a budget and managing financial obligations. Supplemental Security Income, a program that provides additional income for people with disabilities and adults aged 65 and older with limited or no income, is distributed separately from Social Security benefits at the beginning of every month. RELATED EDUCATION April checks will be issued:1 April 1- SSI payments for April will be issued.April 3 - Benefits will be paid to those who have been collecting since before May 1997.April 8 - Benefits will be paid to those born between the first and the 10th of any month.April 15 - Benefits will be paid to those with birthdays between the 11th and the 20th of any month.April 22 - Benefits will be paid to those with birthdays between the 21st and the 31st of any month.
